- Interpret “same characters” as: the set of distinct letters in both strings must be identical (order and counts irrelevant).  
- Compute set0 = set(s0) and set1 = set(s1); return set0 == set1.  
- Optionally early-return False if either string is empty while the other is not and contains any non-empty set (implicitly covered by set equality).
